facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on April 8, 2021 that clients can now purchase digital audio inventory through an expanded relationship with Magnite.
facts.quote: announced clients may now purchase digital audio inventory, thanks to an expanded relationship with Magnite, the largest independent sell-side advertising platform.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's announcement, the programmatic audio inventory accessible through StackAdapt reaches over 625 million unique monthly listeners.
facts.quote: Global media buyers using StackAdapt can now access programmatic audio inventory, reaching over 625 million unique monthly listeners

facts.fact: Magnite states that the world's leading agencies and brands execute billions of advertising transactions each month on its platform.
facts.quote: execute billions of advertising transactions each month
